name: Do I need a permit to remove a load-bearing wall in Clark County, Nevada?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit to remove a load-bearing wall in Clark County, Nevada?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, removing a load-bearing wall in Clark County, including Las Vegas, North Las Vegas, and Henderson, absolutely requires a building permit. This is a significant structural alteration, and local building codes mandate permits to ensure the work is done safely and correctly according to engineering specifications. Attempting to remove a load-bearing wall without a permit can lead to fines, stop-work orders, difficulty selling your home, and serious safety hazards.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, a building permit is required in Clark County for load-bearing wall removal to ensure safety and compliance with local building codes.
